Understanding Traumatic Brain Injuries (TBI)

A traumatic brain injury occurs when sudden trauma damages brain function. This can result from falls, motor vehicle accidents, assaults, or workplace incidents. TBI victims often face devastating consequences including memory loss, cognitive impairment, and emotional changes.

The medical costs and lost wages from a TBI can be substantial. Our experienced attorneys understand the complexities of these cases and fight tirelessly for the compensation you deserve.

Our Services

Motor Vehicle Accident TBI Claims

Car, truck, and motorcycle accidents are leading causes of traumatic brain injury. If negligent driving caused your injury, you have the right to pursue compensation. We investigate all aspects of your accident to build a strong case. Learn more about TBI claims from vehicle accidents.

Workplace Brain Injury Representation

Construction sites, manufacturing facilities, and other workplaces can be dangerous. When workplace negligence or unsafe conditions cause brain injury, workers' compensation may not be sufficient. Explore your options for workplace injury claims.

Medical Negligence and Surgical Errors

Medical professionals have a duty to provide safe, competent care. When surgical errors or medical negligence causes brain injury, victims deserve justice. Consult about medical malpractice cases.

Assault and Violent Crime Injuries

Victims of assault or violent crime resulting in TBI may pursue both criminal justice and civil compensation. Our attorneys have extensive experience with these sensitive cases. Get help after violent injuries.

Fall-Related Brain Injuries

Falls are a common cause of TBI, especially in premises liability situations. Property owners have a responsibility to maintain safe environments. Learn about fall injury compensation.

Sports and Recreation Injuries

Athletes and recreational participants can suffer serious brain injuries. If negligence or inadequate safety measures contributed to your injury, you may have legal recourse. Understand sports injury liability.

Birth Injuries and Cerebral Palsy

Medical errors during pregnancy, labor, or delivery can cause devastating brain injuries to newborns. Families deserving compensation should work with experienced attorneys. Learn about birth injury claims.

Why Choose Our Firm

We bring decades of combined experience in traumatic brain injury cases. Our attorneys understand the medical, legal, and financial aspects of TBI litigation. We've recovered millions in compensation for injured clients across the United States.

We treat every client with compassion and dedication. Your recovery and well-being are our top priorities. Additionally, we work on a contingency basis, meaning you pay no fees unless we win your case.

Contact us for a free consultation to discuss your traumatic brain injury claim. Email us: support@legal-counsel.net

How the Process Works

  1. Free Consultation: We listen to your story and evaluate your case at no cost or obligation.
  2. Investigation: Our team gathers medical records, accident reports, and expert testimony.
  3. Settlement Negotiation: We pursue fair compensation through insurance company negotiations.
  4. Trial Preparation: If settlement fails, we prepare your case for courtroom presentation.
  5. Recovery: Upon successful resolution, we ensure you receive full compensation promptly.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How long do I have to file a TBI lawsuit?

A: Statutes of limitations vary by state, typically ranging from 2-4 years. However, this clock may start from the date of injury or discovery. Contact us immediately to protect your rights and learn your deadline.

Q: What damages can I recover in a TBI case?

A: You may recover medical expenses, lost wages, pain and suffering, and future care costs. Learn about compensation types for brain injuries. In cases of gross negligence, punitive damages may also apply.

Q: Can I still file a claim if I was partially at fault?

A: Most states allow comparative negligence claims. Even if you were partially responsible, you may recover reduced compensation. Our attorneys understand these complex rules and fight for maximum recovery.

Q: How much is my TBI case worth?

A: Case value depends on injury severity, medical costs, lost earnings, and long-term care needs. Discover what similar cases have recovered. We provide honest valuations based on comparable settlements.

Q: Will my case go to trial?

A: Most cases settle without trial, but we prepare every case for courtroom presentation. Our trial experience ensures insurers take settlement negotiations seriously, often resulting in better outcomes for our clients.

Time is critical in injury cases. Evidence fades, witnesses move away, and your legal rights have time limits. Email us today at support@legal-counsel.net to schedule your free consultation. Let us take this burden off your shoulders while you focus on recovery.
